book: Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Examinations — R.S. Aggarwal
source_note: Extracted and sanitized from R.S. Aggarwal Chapter 7: Problems on Numbers. Complete 133 objective questions with accurate mathematical formulas, clean text, options, and solutions.

key_explanation.title: Key concepts and formulas from the book

topics.explanation: If a number is x, its fractional part is f*x. A two-digit number with ten's digit x and unit's digit y is 10x + y. Reversing the digits gives 10y + x.
Consecutive integers: x, x+1, x+2... Consecutive even/odd numbers: x, x+2, x+4...
Key algebraic identities: (a+b)² = a² + b² + 2ab; (a-b)² = a² + b² - 2ab; a² - b² = (a-b)(a+b); (a+b)² - (a-b)² = 4ab.
Sum of a number x and its reciprocal 1/x is x + 1/x = (x² + 1)/x. If numerator is N and denominator D, fraction is N/D.
